verify.note: One arm per fixed alert site, read from the tree (the alert list itself needs the GitHub API). Property injection: FIELD_PATH, QUESTION_ID and SLUG_RE are regexp literals anchored at both ends with no bare dot, negated or shorthand class, and each guard sits before the write in updateImportField, cleanAnswers and withPageDoc. Randomness: getSessionId goes through newVisitId, which uses getRandomValues and no Math.random; lib/demo/generate.ts has no Math.random. Bypass: the click route computes verifyClickUrl as a plain const (not inside a condition) before resolveSendForTracking; runDemoDecay and previewDemoDecay take no argument. Bad tag filter: imports lib/ai/web/index.ts under type stripping and checks htmlToText drops a script, style and noscript body whose end tag carries junk. Then one arm each for the escaping, file-to-http (PR_NUMBER test, every return Number(raw) or null), fs race (no statSync), never-null compare, unused statuses filter, two useless initial values and five trivial conditionals. Fails on main at 3be7bedd4 on its first arm. Mutation-fired: each of the 20 touched source and test files reverted to main alone; FIELD_PATH start anchor dropped; a bare dot in FIELD_PATH; QUESTION_ID end anchor dropped; a negated class in QUESTION_ID; the QUESTION_ID guard moved after the write; the signature check short-circuited on the destination; the send read moved before the check; the style end tag narrowed back to </style\s*>; newVisitId given a Math.random tail; help-autodoc returning Number(raw) past the test.

CLOSED 2026-09-29. ADR-1634. PREMISE RE-TESTED (ADR-1082): no session tool reads the alert list, so the set was reproduced the way .github/workflows/codeql.yml builds it: CodeQL 2.27.1, a javascript-typescript database over origin/main at 3be7bedd4 minus design_handoff and public/maplibre (the workflow paths-ignore), and the security-and-quality suite. 37 results in 12 rules (the screenshot read 36; each of the 37 is handled, so the gap hides nothing).

BEFORE -> AFTER, per rule: js/xss-through-dom 10 -> 0 (HYG-142 / ADR-1637, not this row: all ten sites render through safeUploadPreviewSrc or safeImageSrc); js/remote-property-injection 8 -> 0; js/trivial-conditional 5 -> 0; js/insecure-randomness 4 -> 0; js/user-controlled-bypass 2 -> 0; js/useless-assignment-to-local 2 -> 0; js/bad-tag-filter, js/incomplete-sanitization, js/file-access-to-http, js/file-system-race, js/comparison-between-incompatible-types, js/property-access-on-non-object 1 -> 0 each. AFTER is the same suite over this branch with lib/safe-image-src.ts from the HYG-142 branch before it merged: 0 results. The merged copy (#3047) keeps the shape CodeQL reads (every return is null or a value an anchored regexp just accepted) but was not re-scanned here. Nothing dismissed.

WHAT SHIPPED. Anchored allowlists before a request value becomes an object key (business seeder field paths, guest seat answer keys, Space page doc slugs); the click redirect verifies the signature first on every request and only then reads the send; the demo decay action is two actions instead of a browser-sent dry-run flag; the observe visit id and the demo generator draw on Web Crypto / node:crypto; htmlToText ends script/style/noscript at </tag plus anything up to >; help-autodoc lets only a digits-only PR number into the API path; check-build-fanout reads a chunk once; and the code-quality alerts each remove the dead line they name. New tests: app/(main)/e/c/[token]/route.test.ts, lib/analytics/observe.test.ts, plus cases in the seat actions, profile pages, business seeder, htmlToText and completion analytics suites.
